views.markdown: Revives the Lyrication tweak: fixes lyrics fetching after the original textyl.co API went down, now pulling from LRCLIB instead. The lock screen LX button hooks directly into com.apple.MediaRemoteUI on iOS 16+ and positions itself against the real transport controls, since the lock screen content on those versions isn't drawn by SpringBoard.

### 2.5.2
Fixed the LX button dropping out of line when the lock screen player is expanded to full screen (iOS 16).

### 2.5.1
Initial release
